about: Phrases that suggest a person may be in crisis or thinking about self-harm. Kept short and conservative. Matching shows a supportive notice; it never blocks the user, never diagnoses, and the text is never stored. Changes need a reason in the PR and, ideally, review by a counsellor or faculty member (see docs/SECURITY_PRIVACY.md section 5).
phrases: don't want to be here anymore
dont want to be here anymore
message: It sounds like things might be really heavy right now. You don't have to go through it alone, and talking to someone can help.
